name: Piyestra Supreme Double Layer Foam Mattress
description: 4-inch Piyestra Supreme Double Layer foam mattress crafted for firm orthopaedic support and everyday comfort. Backed by a 7-year manufacturer warranty.
details: The Piyestra Supreme Double Layer Foam Mattress is built to provide balanced spinal support and comfortable sleep for Sri Lankan homes. Featuring a dual-density foam construction—combining a firm high-density bonded foam base layer with a softer comfort foam top layer—it prevents sagging while promoting proper airflow and heat release. Covered in a durable printed fabric cover, this 4-inch mattress is ideal for everyday family use and comes backed by a 7-year manufacturer warranty on the foam.
